events.title: Debuilders Live — Playing the Free Demo on Next Fest!

events.title: Debuilders at Steam Next Fest — the demo is live!

events.title: Hotfix #5: Bug fixes 🐞
events.summary: HELLO, DEBUILDERS!Today, a lot of work was done on the animations. Now playing will be much more enjoyable!In the near future, there will be more updates to the animations and physics. Very soon, the demo will be presented in its full form. Stay tuned!

events.title: Hotfix #4: Bug fixes 🐞
events.summary: HELLO, DEBUILDERS!We’ve prepared a new batch of improvements and fixes for you:The cylinders in the lobby are now working as they should ✅The shaking of the vase has been fixed ✅A hint has been added to the tablet on the second quota for Molbert’s task (we know it was hard to figure out the task before. Now it will definitely be easier) ✅In the coming days, you’ll also see major improvements to the animations and physics. We’ll be in touch!

events.title: Hotfix #1: Bug fixes🐞
events.summary: Hello, debuilders!We noticed one critical bug that killed the opportunity to pass the second quota (it was impossible to pick up the pipe wrench). We urgently got behind the fix and now everything is working as it should!We hope that now you will be able to fully enjoy our demo. Have a nice game!

events.title: 🚧 The construction site is open! The DEBUILDERS demo is available right now!
